note: The kerrans' stilt village on Kerra Isle, off Odus, the wild island (no city of the erudites stands there yet: the words name none). Its people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Kerra Isle): Elder Ssharu, on the village's landward side, gives the first two; Huntress Kazhra, beside her, the three hunts; Weaver Shimra, under the first stilt house to the north-east, is the outfitter; Coachman Tolhra keeps the stable a few steps north (his coach, and the ferry that carries it, runs to Freeport and to the other homes). The isle crabs (the sand spit to the north), the fern vipers (the ferns to the west) and the great crab Old Snapclaw (the island's far south-west) are placed for these quests. Levels 7-20 (2026-11-11): Huntress Kazhra gives L7-L15, Elder Ssharu the L20 path; their objectives are on the Homelands' shared ground, the Goldfeather Eyrie (Tolhra's coach): drift rats and badgers, rime spider silk for Shimra's grips, Old Frostjaw (cat to cat), the Rimeheart's shard to Scout Feyla, then Feyla's raiders, their talons shown to Warden Halvek.

L1.name: A Cub's Claw Band
offer: Mrrr. A new cub, with its eyes barely open. Come, let me look at you. Yes. You will do.
Every cub of the isle wears a claw band, woven of palm and its mother's fur, until its first hunt. Weaver Shimra makes them, under the first stilt house to the north-east.
Will you fetch your claw band and show it to me?
L1.declined: Then curl up in the sun a while. I often do.
L1.started: Shimra sits under the first stilt house, north-east of here.

piece.name: cub's claw band
piece.description: A band of woven palm and soft fur. Every cub of Kerra Isle wears one until its first hunt.

fetch.journal: Ask Weaver Shimra, under the stilt house north-east of Elder Ssharu, for a cub's claw band.
fetch.says: The elder's new cub? Paw out. Claws in, please. There: palm for the island, fur for the pride. A cub pays nothing.

show.journal: Show the cub's claw band to Elder Ssharu.
show.says: It suits you. Wear it, and every kerran on the isle will know whose cub you are.

L2.name: Nine Lives, One Home
offer: They say a kerran has nine lives. Do not count on it. Have Spiritmaster Talhrin bind your spirit to the isle, so that you wake here whichever life you lose.
Then give your name to Coachman Tolhra for his ledger. His coach, and the ferry that carries it, runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then keep out of the deep water until you do.
L2.started: Talhrin is across the village, to the east. Tolhra waits a few steps north of here.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Talhrin, east of the elder, bind your spirit to the isle.
bind.says: It is done. Lose a life where you will, cub, and you will wake here in the sun. Now go and give Coachman Tolhra your name.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Tolhra, a few steps north of the elder, for his ledger.
ledger.says: A cub off the isle at last! My coach rides the ferry over, then runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for those whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Good. Now the isle will always have you back.
Tolhra's coach goes where its ledgers know you, but the crossing to Qeynos is earned. Huntress Kazhra, beside me, has work for you.

L3.name: Crabs on the Sand
offer: So this is the new cub. Good. Isle crabs are thick on the sand spit north of the village, and they have been cutting the fishers' nets.
Go and pounce on a few, and bring me three of their claws. Then I will teach you something every hunter knows.
Will you hunt them?
L3.declined: Then the fishers mend nets tonight, and curse your name.
L3.started: Three claws. North, out along the sand. Mind your tail.

drop.name: isle crab claw
drop.description: The claw of an isle crab from the sand spit north of the kerrans' village.

hunt.journal: Take three isle crab claws from the isle crabs on the sand spit north of the village.

give.journal: Bring three isle crab claws to Huntress Kazhra.
give.says: Three claws, and your tail unpinched. You can hunt. Now watch closely, and learn this.

L4.name: A Cub's Arms
offer: Claws are a fine start, but the mainland wants more. I will make you proper gear, if you bring me what I need.
Weaver Shimra has leather and cord for me. Then take a fang from the fern vipers that coil in the ferns west of the village.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then keep to your claws, and to the isle.
L4.started: Leather and cord from Shimra, a fang from the vipers. Go softly.

materials.journal: Ask Weaver Shimra for the leather strip and the silk cord.
materials.says: For Kazhra? Here: a strip of leather and a silk cord. Tell her she still owes me a fish. A large one.

drop.name: fern viper fang
drop.description: The fang of a fern viper from the ferns west of the kerrans' village.

hunt.journal: Take a fern viper fang from the fern vipers among the ferns west of the village.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the silk cord and the fern viper fang to Huntress Kazhra.
give.says: All three. Sit a moment while I work... there. It is yours. Keep it as sharp as your claws.

L5.name: Old Snapclaw
offer: One hunt more, cub. A great crab we call Old Snapclaw has the far south-west of the island, and it took a fisher's tail last moon.
It does not scuttle off like the small ones. It comes for you. Stand, strike, and bring me its claw.
Will you hunt Old Snapclaw?
L5.declined: It will only grow, and so will its temper.
L5.started: South-west, through the ferns, to the island's end. Keep your tail behind you.

drop.name: Old Snapclaw's claw
drop.description: The great notched claw of the crab Old Snapclaw of Kerra Isle.

hunt.journal: Take Old Snapclaw's claw from the great crab Old Snapclaw at the island's far south-west.

give.journal: Bring Old Snapclaw's claw to Huntress Kazhra.
says: Old Snapclaw's own claw! The fishers will purr for a week. You are a cub no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Raszhar at the water's edge, north-east of the village, when you are ready to cross.

flight.name: Across the Water
offer: The humans of Qeynos trade with our boats and train our young as their own. Rangers and druids go to their Surefall Glade.
You have earned the crossing, hunter. I will set you down among your own guild there, and your spirit will rest in Qeynos.
Shall I send you across the water?
flight.started: Keep your claws sharp and your fur dry!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Raszhar when you are ready to cross to Qeynos.

L7.name: A Hunt in the Snow
offer: Mrrr. Your claws are longer now. Time you hunted somewhere colder than the isle. The Homelands keep an outpost on the frozen river under the Goldfeather Eyrie.
Take Tolhra's coach there. On the snow east of it are drift rats and badgers. Bring me two of each: fur and pelts.
Will you hunt the snow for me?
L7.declined: Stay by the fire, then. Your paws will thank you.
L7.started: Low and quiet. Snow shows every track.

drop.name: drift rat fur
drop.description: A clump of white fur from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

hunt.journal: Take two clumps of drift rat fur from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.

drop.name: snowfield badger pelt
drop.description: The thick pelt of a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two snowfield badger pelts from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the drift rat fur and the badger pelts to Huntress Kazhra.
give.says: Two and two, and your ears not frozen off. A real hunt. Now watch closely, and learn this.

L10.name: Silk for a Grip
offer: Your arms are a cub's arms still. Shimra weaves grips that never slip, wet paws or dry, but palm will not do for what you need now.
The rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost spin a frosted silk. Bring me three skeins, and Shimra and I will make you something better.
Will you bring me the silk?
L10.declined: Then keep the cub's arms a while.
L10.started: Three skeins. Spiders bite. So do you.

drop.name: rime spider silk
drop.description: A skein of frosted silk from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take three skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the three skeins of rime spider silk to Huntress Kazhra.
give.says: Fine silk. Shimra will purr. Sit a moment while we work... there. It is yours. Keep it as sharp as your claws.

L13.name: The Old Cat of the Slopes
offer: There is an old snow leopard on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost. Frostjaw, they call him. He kills the outpost's hunters, and not for hunger.
A cat who hunts like that shames every cat. Bring him down. Take friends from the other homes. He is older than you, and wiser.
Will you hunt Old Frostjaw?
L13.started: Do not stalk him. He will smell you. Meet him head on.

hunt.journal: Kill Old Frostjaw on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

back.says: Frostjaw is gone. Good. Cat to cat, it had to be one of us. Learn this.

L15.name: A Shard for the Scout
offer: Scout Feyla, on the river by the Eyrie, hunts as well as any kerran. She sent word: the cold from the ice caves north-east of the outpost is spreading. The Rimeheart.
Break it, and take a shard to Feyla so she knows it is done. Then come back and tell me.
Will you face the Rimeheart for Feyla?
L15.started: Go with others. That much cold is no place for one cat.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

carry.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Scout Feyla, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
carry.says: You broke it? I felt the cold ease this morning. Tell Kazhra she taught you well.

back.says: Feyla says I taught you well. Mrrr. I did. Learn this.

L20.name: The Hunter's Crossing
offer: Kazhra says you are a hunter now, not a cub. A hunter of the isle proves it once on strange ground, so the other homes know our claws.
Go to Scout Feyla on the frozen river under the Goldfeather Eyrie. Do what she asks. Then come back to me, and choose your path.
Will you make the hunter's crossing?
L20.declined: The isle is patient. Eat something first.
L20.started: Land on your feet, cub. Hunter, I mean.

road.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: Kazhra's hunter. Good. The Goldfeather raiders carry war-talons. Take three, then show them to Warden Halvek at the outpost.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the three war-talons to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
handin.says: Three talons, and Feyla's word on you. The isle breeds hunters. Go home and tell your elder.

final.journal: Return to Elder Ssharu on Kerra Isle.
final.says: You crossed as a cub and came home a hunter. The isle has one more thing to give you.
